text:
ana: Heads-up: External security assessment next Fri. We need a compact plan for RBAC, KMS scoping, and immutable audit snapshots. Draft: ephemeral role for assessors, KMS allow Decrypt+GenerateDataKey scoped to single key, presigned-only S3 uploads into object-locked bucket, and an automated teardown. Feedback?

kevin: Thumbs-up. Important: require session principal tags and avoid any kms:* permissions. TTL for role creds?

maria: Suggest issuing creds via our OIDC provider (1h staging, 2h prod) and attaching `aws:PrincipalTag/session_type=assessor`. We'll only issue during a named window.

devsec-bot: Policy guidance: prefer key-policy restrictions + IAM conditions. Presign example: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/assessor/output.tgz --expires-in 3600`

ana: (typo) ana: Also add `aws:RequestTag/pt_id=PT-501` on all KMS requests so we can filter later.

kevin: Compliance wants object lock governance + 90d retention on the audit bucket. Also insist legal signs NDA before any presigned URLs are handed out.

legal: I'll send NDA link and confirm vendor scope excludes customer datasets. If scope touches customer data we need a DPA amendment.

maria: Ops revert snippet:```\n#!/bin/bash\naws iam detach-role-policy --role-name assessor-pt501 --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/pt-assessor-pt501\naws iam delete-role --role-name assessor-pt501 || true\n# revoke OIDC sessions\n```

sre-oncall: I can own the prod window. Proposed slot: Fri Apr 25 08:30-10:30 PT. I'll mark calendar and notify oncall.

ana: I'll own redaction checks for PII before uploads. Will run automated scrub and add checksum to manifest.

ana: final checklist for PT-501: 1) NDA signed (Legal) 2) Staging dry-run with presign (Ops) 3) Policy + session tags verified (Kevin) 4) Redaction ready (Ana) 5) Audit snapshot schedule (SRE) 6) Teardown script tested (Ops). Please ack ownerships so I can finalize runbook.
